definitions.speedup: Official single-core cycles / plan cycles; arithmetic and geometric means of ratios are reported separately.
definitions.cycles: Official simulated cycles including movement/synchronization, not generator process wall time.
definitions.copy: scheduled_copy_bytes; original + signed partition delta + spill. 1 MiB = 1048576 bytes.
definitions.generation: One serial process wall-time measurement per case, including input/output, excluding separate scoring.
definitions.comparison: v5 fixed-work historical runs; n5 additionally compared to historical v6 15-second runs. Different budgets/strategies, not a controlled CPU-speed benchmark.
definitions.cores: Available core limit; solver may use fewer cores.
definitions.sums: Sums of independent cases, not one combined workload.
definitions.retention: All 40 new plans retained; no per-case fallback to historical plans.
